variants.display_name: PaddleOCR-VL-1.6 · vLLM batch 4 across GPUs · BF16 embedding, 16 chunks
variants.change_description: From the FP32 control: use BF16 embeddings and reduce embedding batch size from 32 to 16 chunks. OCR settings are unchanged.

outcome_note.summary: BF16/16-chunk embeddings reduced p50 from 5.39 to 4.19 s (1.29×); all 30 calls passed.
outcome_note.next: OCR dominates the new NACA profile. Test a wider region submission window and dynamic page scheduling separately.
